reviews.title: 32 GB can do
reviews.comment: Good 32 GB of RAM, in a single memory slot. Working perfect in a Samsung laptop, with AMD 3500. This is a better amount of RAM for Windows 10 and 11, if you are doing allot of stuff at once.. My other laptop has 16 GB, and if there are a whole bunch of tabs open, it can have some lag, or problems with active tabs using up too much memory. $65 was a decent price for this PNY memory.

reviews.title: 10 outta 10 RAMS}}}}}}}}}}
reviews.comment: I went from 16gb to 32gb on my Alienware gaming laptop, and this made a big difference right away. I was hitting VRAM limits on a couple of newer games I loaded up, and now I'm running them on Ultra instead of 2560 or 1920 resolutions. I've used PNY products in the past, and they have always been good items. UPDATE: 11-01-2025, This laptop has always run hot for even minor intensive computering, and gaming. I mean hot hot to the touch where the top vents are located. Doubling up the RAM to 32gb has been a revelation. The unit doesn't get searing hot anymore, and I barely hear the cooling fan too. Cooling fan was very loud during heavy game play, but not now. Load times, and game play for 4k games have gotten a lot smoother on higher settings.

reviews.title: PNY 64 gig ddr4 laptop memory
reviews.comment: I'm always like PNY memory I've used PNY my memory for my microSD card need. I got these after considering getting the crucial memory over these but I'm glad I went and got the PNY memory instead aesthetic was they look pretty cool with the black look. I put it in my MSI gaming laptop and everything worked fine on the first boot it's definitely made my laptop a lot faster to have the extra memory in there so don't have to run out of system resources. If you need ddr4 laptop memory this stuff is top notch I did add a rafting copper Cooling he says to them that are very thin and it seems to be keeping my thermals in check really well in a closed location of my MSI gaming laptop. And I'm glad I got them during Christmas sale as they are a great deal at that time for the price that they were asking for them I think I only paid $19 for them and now they're going for like $160 something dollars or more. The nice thing about this memory too is if I get another type of laptop I can bring them with me and just put back in the old ones in my laptop as they are premium memory and they are also cast latency 22 they don't support XMP that would have been a nice feature to have with my laptop but it depends on the laptop not the memory. I would definitely recommend them as a must buy
reviews.author: Kenneth Ketchum

reviews.title: love this!
reviews.comment: I upgrade my old laptop with this PNY 32GB DDR4 kit and it work perfect. Before was only 8GB and system lag when open many tabs or VM. Now it run smooth and no freeze. Speed is 3200MHz like say and my BIOS detect no problem. Dual rank also, so better performance for multitask. Install easy, just plug in and boot. No XMP but for laptop not matter. Voltage is 1.2V so safe and low heat. I test with memtest86 and no error found. Good RAM for price. Not fancy heatsink or RGB but for work and dev, this is best deal. Recommend for upgrade laptop if you need more memory and don't want spend too much.
